title: Fate Marable, his record and Sidney Desvigne
summary: Discussion of Fate Marable's one record, a claim about his calliope job, and his band with Amos White and Sidney Desvigne.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Oh he's a master. And you know, uh, Fate Marble? You heard of Fate Marble? From the boat?
Yeah. Yeah you know him too. Well that's where, you know. He made one record, you know, but I don't think it really showed him off too good, you know.

Sometimes those records don't always come out fair to the file. You know what Manion told me about Fate, I can't hardly believe it, I don't know what you think about it. He told me he's taking Fate's job on the callio. And I don't think, I can't see how Manion could qualify to take Fate's job. Did you ever hear Fate play? You never heard? I never did, except on that one record.

Maybe he had a humbug with the boss or something. It wasn't so good at one record, huh? Well no, it was all right, but it wasn't great, you know. Is that right? It wasn't great. You could do a band with him. He had Amos White and Sidney Desveen. Sidney Desveen, yes.
Sidney Desveen, he died just some time ago. He ain't been long past Sidney. No, not too long.
No, I guess you know about it. Let me turn the machine off a second. Let's see, what were we talking about?
Oh, he was talking about the different piano players around Chicago. Yeah. Yeah, they were good.
